IC2: preserved left ventricular ejection fraction [AND] (>= 50%) on echocardiography
IC3: HEALTHY: normal cardiac structure [OR] and function on echocardiography, BP < 140/90
IC4: HYPERTENSIVE: history of BP >140/90, 1 or more antihypertensive medications, LV ejection fraction (LVEF) at least 50%, current BP < 160/90
IC5: HFpEF: physician-confirmed diagnosis of HF, symptomatic HF, LVEF at least 50%, elevated LV filling pressure [AND] by catheterization, echocardiographic criteria or B-type-natriuretic peptide > 100, current BP < 160/90
